planariumview.config.title: Planarium Panorama
planariumview.config.radius.tooltip:
Area around the Planarium where scenery follows block changes, with animations, particles and sounds according to your settings.

Distance is measured in blocks of the outside world.
planariumview.config.far_radius.tooltip:
Scenery range around the Planarium, measured in blocks of the outside world. Beyond the %1$s, terrain is a snapshot of the blocks, updated by full refreshes.

Scenery also updates as the Planarium moves.

OFF: scenery ends at the %1$s.
planariumview.config.neighbors.tooltip:
Shows the interiors of up to this many Planariums within the %s, nearest first.

Blocks and lighting captured when you enter the Planarium, without chests, mobs or particles.

On a Sable structure, only Planariums on that same structure are shown.
planariumview.config.refresh.tooltip:
Regularly updates scenery blocks within the %1$s and beyond, along with paintings, item frames and armor stands.

OFF: nearby block changes still follow %2$s. Mobs, sky and sounds keep their own settings.
planariumview.config.fog.tooltip:
How far the scenery remains visible before fading into fog.

OFF: no fog.

Scenery edge: fog hides the outer edge of the scenery.

Render distance: uses Minecraft's render distance. The snapshot beyond the %s is not shown.
planariumview.config.lighting.tooltip:
OFF: Ars Nouveau lighting, without the outside sky.

Sky and scenery: shows the outside sky and applies real lighting to the scenery and miniature. The Planarium's interior stays fully lit.

Full: also applies outside lighting to the Planarium's interior: day, night and nearby lamps.
planariumview.config.biome.tooltip:
In the scenery: grass, leaf and water colors from the outside biomes.

Inside the Planarium: colors, music, ambient sounds and particles from the biome where the Planarium stands.
planariumview.config.ambience.tooltip:
Plays Dynamic Surroundings ambience for the Planarium's outside location, including biome and cave sounds.

Also applies its biome fog colors inside the Planarium. With %s enabled, its fireflies appear around flowers in the scenery and miniatures.
planariumview.config.server_controlled: Set by the server you are playing on.
planariumview.config.enabled.tooltip: Master switch. OFF: everything is like in Ars Nouveau (no giant scenery, black sky, Ars lighting). Your other choices are kept.
planariumview.config.weather.tooltip: Outside rain, snow and lightning: rain and snow fall on the scenery with the rain sound, you hear the thunder and see nearby bolts.
planariumview.config.clouds.tooltip: Outside clouds appear in the Planarium when it is near the cloud layer. Follows the Clouds video setting.
planariumview.config.clouds.other_mod: %s is installed: the clouds in the Planarium will be vanilla clouds, unlike the ones outside. Turn this off if you prefer no clouds in the Planarium.
planariumview.config.reenter: Some changes only fully apply after leaving and re-entering the Planarium.
planariumview.config.block_updates.toolt:
Maximum time for block changes within the %1$s to appear in the scenery.

Shorter delays increase server load in active areas (farms, redstone...).

OFF: changes wait for the next %2$s.
planariumview.config.ambient_sounds.tool: Plays AmbientSounds ambience inside the Planarium based on where the Planarium is: dimension, biome, weather, height and nearby blocks.
planariumview.config.scenery_particles.t:
Shows smoke, flames, drips and other particles from scenery blocks, plus outside explosions.

Particles follow the scale of each view: 32 times larger in the giant scenery and 32 times smaller in miniatures.

Follows Minecraft's %s setting: fewer with Decreased, none with Minimal.
planariumview.config.scenery_ambience.to:
Sounds made by blocks in the scenery: flowing water, fire, lava, portals and campfires. They come from the blocks' direction.

These sounds can play even when the outside area is inactive.
planariumview.config.world_sounds.toolti:
Sounds of redstone, explosions and jukeboxes around the Planarium. Sounds caused directly by players are excluded.

Mob sounds follow the Outside mobs setting.
planariumview.config.outside_vehicles.to: Shows boats, rafts and minecarts in the giant scenery. Mob passengers also require %s.
planariumview.config.outside_vehicles.wa: Keeps the %s and a small margin active so vehicles can move.
planariumview.config.outside_live.toolti: Keeps mobs and machines around the Planarium active during your visit. Required for outside mobs and vehicles.
planariumview.config.world_closed: Open a world to change this setting.
planariumview.config.world_sounds.live_o: %s is OFF: sounds are only heard from areas already running.
planariumview.config.miniature_live.tool: Keeps a Planarium running while a player looks at its miniature up close: mobs move, furnaces cook and redstone works. Up to 4 Planariums at once by default.
planariumview.config.miniature_live_view: The nearest miniature you look at (within 8 blocks) shows its mobs moving.
planariumview.config.miniature_mobs.tool: Maximum mobs per miniature. Without live updates, they stay at their last position with idle animations. 0 = OFF.
Shows boats, rafts and minecarts in miniatures, up to 64 per Planarium. They move when live updates are enabled.

Independent of the mob limit. Mob passengers are shown when miniature mobs are enabled.
planariumview.config.outside_mobs.toolti:
Maximum mobs visible in the giant scenery, with their sounds. 0 = OFF.

Mobs may take a few seconds to appear.
planariumview.config.outside_mobs.warnin: Keeps the %s and a small margin active so mobs can move.
planariumview.config.cave_fog.tooltip:
Fog color when the Planarium is in an enclosed cave.

Vanilla: the biome's color, darkened according to the time and weather.

Dark: black fog deep in caves with no view of the outside. Elsewhere, uses the Vanilla color.

Biomes that set their own fog color keep it.
planariumview.config.reset.tooltip: Restores default values and saves them immediately.
planariumview.config.sub_levels.tooltip:
Show Sable structures in the giant scenery and miniature.

OFF: they are no longer drawn or captured for you. If the Planarium is on a moving structure, the scenery still follows its movement.

If ships do not reappear after switching this back ON, leave and rejoin the world.
planariumview.config.lunar_events.toolti: The Planarium's moon follows its world's lunar event (blood moon, blue moon...). Requires lighting to be enabled.
